response.sql: WITH employee_groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as num_groups, SUM(employee_count) as total_employees FROM employee_groups) SELECT eg.ReportsTo, eg.employee_count, eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees as share, (eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees) - (1.0 / t.num_groups) as difference_from_avg FROM employee_groups eg CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Employees with NULL ReportsTo are included as a valid group (representing employees with no manager/top-level roles)

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude employees with NULL ReportsTo from the grouping and analysis entirely
